name: @neuropause/nems
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Wave 1 Foundation Platform (NEMS). The production multi-tenant foundation of the internal operating system, composed on the existing platform: real persistence (one database via the persistence SqlDriver), real identity/authorization/sessions (reusing Phase-14 security), the one audit chain and event bus (runtime), and tenant-aware organization/user/dashboard/OKR/settings services. No demo data in the runtime; every mutation is audited and published; every entity is tenant-scoped. No external integrations, AI agents, or billing — those are later waves.
